verification_sequence_note: Full checks and Release build completed before all 18 sequential Release fixtures and benchmarks. The new CLI fixture isolates the original Agent, revokes and replaces identity, checks expiry/reissue, routine rotation and old-backup journal recovery, and distinguishes known usage from observed unreported bytes. An earlier candidate queue was stopped for a UI replay-state correction; only final-binary runs are included. No compiler or performance scripts ran concurrently with benchmarks.

historical_regression_before_fix_scope: An unpublished 0.15.0 candidate checked shortened expiry on edits but omitted the same check when re-enabling a paused node with an earlier expiry. The regression now rejects re-enable before the existing window has ended.

node_execution_lease.scope: separate local release processes; one controller; copied node database; shared budget; TCP and UDP; no cross-host, physical suspend, or multi-controller claim

budget_run_recovery.scope: real SIGKILL; separate local Release processes; original Agent and controller databases; TCP/UDP; single controller; not physical power loss or snapshot completeness

node_identity_replacement.scope: One loopback host; real CLI processes and original-node control isolation. No Linux/WAN, adversarial-host shutdown or per-rule quota claim; quota fencing has separate Rust integration coverage.

node_credential_rotation.scope: One macOS loopback host, real CLI processes, temporary fault-injection proxy; no Linux/WAN or compromise-replacement claim.

verified_capabilities: Tenant-scoped identity revocation and one-time replacement enrollment with revisions, expiry and exact operation retries
Atomic retirement of recorded credentials and enrollment tokens; delayed old-operation retries cannot mutate later identity
Fresh-state replacement waits through the already-issued strict execution window; cold restart retains full TTL quarantine
Offline replacement requires explicit external-stop attestation and migration to a strict lease policy
All historical quota periods are fenced; unknown reservations remain committed and no unreported usage is invented
Replacement enrollment response loss recovers the same durable candidate and actual credential revision
Real CLI isolation/revoke/reissue/restore reports 800 observed bytes, 640 known bytes and 704 bytes of held original reservation
Shared TCP/UDP test backends reserve both sockets before starting to avoid parallel ephemeral-port collisions
Tenant-scoped credential rotation requests, version checks, persisted candidates, atomic retirement and exact idempotent receipts
Actual TCP/UDP and lease continuity during concurrent renewal; offline queued rotation and pre/post-commit SIGKILL recovery
Retired credential reuse rejected, old controller backup plus journal preserves rotation history and ledger
Versioned node roles, groups, tags, notes, exact integer cost records and permission-scoped filters
Node profile revisions are independent of forwarding configurations; metadata edits preserve active TCP streams
Atomic 1..100-node profile batches reject stale versions, foreign tenants and storage failures without partial writes
Strict node pause rejects claim and renewal; current authorized windows converge to closed TCP/UDP
Strict expiry caps issued lease duration; offline control cannot keep business open past the received deadline
Live expiry edits and re-enable cannot retroactively shorten an already-issued window
In-process policy clock progresses through observed forward/backward wall-clock changes without reversing
Expired startup reports HTTP 410; extending policy requires normal ownership and durable budget recovery
Release fixture checks 160 unreported bytes after expiry, 1216 exact final bytes, and unchanged forwarding revision
Old controller backup plus complete journal restores all profile fields, names, revisions and ledgers
UI provides identity phase, revoke/replace, explicit new meter periods and replay-aware ticket display alongside node profile editing; browser interaction still pending
All existing transfer, lease, budget recovery, topology, health and multipath regression suites retained
